response.sql:
WITH filtered AS (
    SELECT driverId, points, wins
    FROM driverStandings
    WHERE points > 1.0
), per_driver AS (
    SELECT
        driverId,
        AVG(points) AS avg_points,
        AVG(wins) AS avg_wins
    FROM filtered
    GROUP BY driverId
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_driver_avg_wins
    FROM per_driver
)
SELECT
    p.driverId,
    p.avg_points,
    p.avg_wins,
    p.avg_wins - o.mean_driver_avg_wins AS difference
FROM per_driver AS p
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE o.mean_driver_avg_wins IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: The overall mean is the unweighted mean of each driver's average wins, as specified, and SQLite's AVG ignores NULL values.
